description: Defines memory storage structures and utilities for asynchronous support, including small object optimization and awaitable storage.

classes.name: small_memory_buffer_t
classes.description: A small object optimized memory buffer for storing objects with optional inline storage.

classes.name: awaiter_memory_storage_t
classes.description: A storage class for awaitable objects and their awaiters, supporting inline buffer storage.

classes.name: stored_awaiter
classes.description: A helper struct to store an awaitable and its associated awaiter.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the stored object cast to the specified type.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Constructs an object in the buffer with provided arguments.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Destroys the stored object and resets the buffer.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Stores an awaitable object in the buffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the stored awaitable and awaiter.

methods.name: get_awaiter
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to the stored awaiter's object.

methods.name: get_awaitable
methods.description: Retrieves a reference to the stored awaitable object.
